answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 54 identities means 54 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the fable pair is tracked in the saffron ledger, the plume audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 35%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
